items.q: Do I need to come to your office?
items.a: No. The entire process is handled online and by mail. You will need to have your documents notarized locally, which we will guide you through.

items.q: How long does the process take?
items.a: Typically 2-4 weeks from questionnaire completion to receiving your finalized binder, depending on attorney review time and notarization scheduling.

items.q: Is this a real attorney-client relationship?
items.a: Yes. You sign an engagement letter establishing a formal attorney-client relationship with our licensed California attorney. All communications are confidential.

items.q: What if I need changes after submitting?
items.a: You can request changes at any time before the documents are finalized. After attorney review, we will let you know if we need more information.
Yes. All data is encrypted, and your final documents are stored in a password-protected Dropbox folder shared only with you.

items.q: Do you offer Korean language service?
items.a: Yes. Our entire intake process, questionnaire, and client communications are available in Korean.

engagement.title: Legal Services Agreement
engagement.intro: Please read this agreement carefully. It establishes the attorney-client relationship between you and {attorneyName} of {firmName}.

scope.title: Scope of Services
scope.content: Attorney agrees to prepare the following documents on behalf of Client: (1) Revocable Living Trust; (2) Durable Power of Attorney; (3) Advance Health Care Directive; (4) HIPAA Authorization; (5) Pour-Over Will; and (6) Certificate of Trust. Attorney will review the completed questionnaire, prepare draft documents, and revise based on Client feedback. Attorney's obligations are limited to the preparation and review of the above-listed documents.

fees.title: Fees and Payment
fees.content: Client agrees to pay a flat fee of $1,500 for the complete estate planning package described herein. This fee is earned upon completion of the intake questionnaire and is non-refundable once document preparation has begun. The fee includes one round of revisions.

relationship.title: Attorney-Client Relationship
relationship.content: By signing below, Client acknowledges that an attorney-client relationship is established with {attorneyName}, licensed in the State of California (Bar No. {barNumber}). All communications between Attorney and Client are protected by attorney-client privilege.

limitations.title: Limitations
limitations.content: Attorney's services are limited to California law. This agreement does not include tax advice, financial planning, ongoing legal representation, probate administration, or trust administration after Client's death. Client is responsible for having documents properly executed (signed and notarized) and for funding the trust.

confidentiality.title: Confidentiality
confidentiality.content: Attorney will maintain strict confidentiality of all Client information in accordance with the California Rules of Professional Conduct.
